page.layout: One column of text, with Latin and Arabic lines mixed. Numbers in the right margin beside the entries (230., 235., 236., 249.). Page number 387 at the top right. No running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: AbulHafan Asharienfis[?] 230. ابو الحسن علي بن اسمعيل الاشعري Abu Hafan Ali Ebn Ismail Al Ashari(ab Ashari[?] sed de quo p.45. denominatus.) fecta Ashari[?] pater. Natus anno H.270, vel juxta alios 260. obiit circa an. 330. vel juxta alios 324.

Abu Ali Allobbaensis ابو علي محمد بن عبد الوهاب المعروف بالجبائي Abu Ali Mohammed Ebn Abdul Wahhab, qui vulgo Allobai audit. (scil. à villa quadam Bufrensium dicta جبا Iobe juxta Asfamanum, vel juxta alios à loco quodam in Caufiftan. Ebn Chalec.
Abu Motiat ابو المطيع مكحول بن الفضل الرى Abu Motia Macbul Ebnol Phaali author libri علي اهل البدع &c. 235.
Author libri كنز الاسرار] q.d. Thesaurus secretorum: est is, ابو عبد الله محمد بن سعيد الصنهاجي Aba Abdollah Mohammed Ebn Said Alsonbaji. 236.
Moslemus ابو الحسين مسلم بن الحجاج صاحب Abul Hofain Moslem Ebnol Hajjaj &c: author libri AlSahib. Obiit anno H. 261. annos natus 55.
AlKadi Abu Becr القادي ابو بكر.

Antiftes AlHaramain امام الحرمين (scil. Mecca & Medina) ابو المعالي عبد الملك بن الشيخ ابي محمد عبد الله الملقب ضياء الدين Abul Maali Abdol Malec Ebnol Shaich Ali Mohammed Al dillah cognominatus Dijaeddin, qui vulgò امام الحرمين Emamol Haramain audit, natus anno H. 419. mortuus 478. Ebn Chalec Epit. Tafei. 249.
Abul Hafan [l. Hofain B:frienfis] ابو الحسين محمد بن علي البصري المتكلم Abul Hofain Mohammed Ebn Ali &c. AlBafri, Scholafticus, obiit anno H.436.
Abul Hafan Afpahanienfis (lege Abul Ifaac Elpharaye-nenfis]

page.notes: Arabic lines are transcribed from a small, partly faint scan; the vowel marks and several words are doubtful and are not verified. Marked [?] where uncertain. The first heading word "Asharienfis" and the bracketed "[l. Hofain B:frienfis]" are as they appear on the scan. The Arabic brackets and the printed "Elpharaye-nenfis" line-end are copied as seen.
